## The re-proof outcome (the machinery answer)

- **The hardened egress machinery is verified live end-to-end on the
  evidence leg.** Every completed cell's mediator store carries zero
  5xx, every tunnel `close_cause: eof` with true integer byte counts,
  every `security.egress.requested` decided, `denied_hosts: []` on
  every completed cell. The R-8 checkpoint's early harvest (16 cells
  across prove-plus-comm / make-doom-for-mips /
  torch-tensor-parallelism) was uniformly decided reward 1 — the
  CONNECT-hang class that killed Wc8 is gone.
- **9/10 held members land covering `admit` verdicts** — the first
  covering re-proof verdicts in the Wc line: prove-plus-comm,
  make-doom-for-mips, torch-tensor-parallelism, vulnerable-secret,
  git-leak-recovery, polyglot-c-py, db-wal-recovery,
  sqlite-db-truncate, **query-optimize** (its standing Wc4
  `repair:machinery` discordance did NOT re-occur under epoch-5 on
  the hardened runner — honestly discharged).
- **pypi-server carries a NEW `repair:machinery` discordance** — all
  six cells DECIDED (O + H-pub×3 + H-allow×3) but reward 0 on every
  cell, `denied_hosts: []`, eof-only closes, zero 5xx — the append-only
  discordance register's `classification: machinery` stands verbatim,
  never excluded and never re-scored; a machinery repair for it is a
  further gate's scope.
- **pytorch-model-cli's `allowlist_gap{download.pytorch.org}` is the
  recorded agent-phase legit exclusion** — the whole verify bootstrap
  mediated under epoch-5 (69 eof tunnels per H-allow cell, the torch
  wheel + MNIST dataset fetches flowing), the oracle's own
  `pip install torch --index download.pytorch.org` denied by the AGENT
  layer by design (X-06) → honest grade 0 → the declared exclusion —
  a handled declared-data outcome, never `machinery{h_allow}`, never a
  stop-rule trigger. The store-checker flags the two agent-phase
  `download.pytorch.org` denies outside the epoch's
  permanent_denies∪withheld set — recorded verbatim, same handling as
  smoke2's epoch-consistent agent-phase deny.
- **The dev leg is honestly `incomplete{dead_man}`** — build-pmars /
  cancel-async-tasks landed all-4 decided-1 cells and
  pytorch-model-recovery its H-pub pair, but the in-guest dead-man
  STOPPED the instance at 74/76 cells before the dev packet minted;
  the driver's UTC-minted poll deadline (~13:25Z, ~15 min inside the
  dead-man) expired first → `fail:prove-driver-rc` recorded, never
  rescued. The per-cell evidence stands cited; no covering verdict is
  claimed for the four dev members.
- **First-error-line tally (R-11):** every non-covering cell's first
  verifier-error lines are cited in `run-root/verifier-first-errors.txt`
  — pypi-server cells show a clean bootstrap then the honest grade 0
  (the discordance signature, no crash line); pytorch-model-cli's
  H-allow cells show the `download.pytorch.org` agent-phase deny
  sequence → `weights.json` absent → `Error loading weights`.
- **The post-Wc9 stop rule (A3/R-8) is exercised:** a member carries a
  `machinery{…}` discordance → the line stops here — `blockedOn` plus
  a scope-decision readout carrying the §6 ladder options 2–5 is owed;
